title: Potomac daily mean discharge — original 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 edition

series.unitMeaning: CFS is the receiving spelling of the original ft^3/s; values are unchanged.
series.measurementMeaning: USGS statistic 00003: arithmetic daily mean discharge for its original calendar date.

time.label: end-of-day
time.basis: USGS daily time is the represented local date (https://api.waterdata.usgs.gov/ogcapi/v1/collections/daily/schema?f=html); daily service dates use the time zone in effect at the site (https://waterservices.usgs.gov/docs/dv-service/daily-values-service-details/). USGS-01646500 metadata reports EST and honors daylight saving time (https://waterdata.usgs.gov/monitoring-location/USGS-01646500/; expanded station RDB retrieved 2026-10-12T00:05:02Z, SHA256 509453de95bbc75b657a98ed3416b5545b0d2c8a39714a4e834288f51ea64341). Receiving selection: retain America/New_York local calendar time and label each represented date at next local midnight, without converting the date-only source into a UTC instant.
